test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

A guarantee has been given by the new government to make the long-promised reforms a reality.

options.text: The new government had given a guarantee to make the long-promised reforms a reality.
The guarantee had given a new government to make the long-promised reforms a reality.
The new government has given a guarantee to make the long-promised reforms a reality.
The new government has given the long-promised reforms a reality to make a guarantee.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****The new government has given a guarantee to make the long-promised reforms a reality.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** active voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject (objective case) + has been + past participle + Object (subjective case) (Passive voice) + adjunct
 
• **Subject + has + past tense + Object (Active voice) + adjunct**
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He has been taken out by me. (Passive voice)*
 
• *I have taken him out. (Active voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject (objective case) **of the given sentence is ‘a guarantee’.
 
• The **object (subjective case) **of the given sentence is ‘The new government’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **has been given** will be changed to **has given**.
 
• **Adjunct **is a word or phrase that constitutes an optional element or is considered of secondary importance in a sentence
 
 
• In the given sentence, *to make the long-promised reforms a reality *is the **adjunct. **
 
 

Correct sentence - The new government has given a guarantee to make the long-promised reforms a reality.
